I don’t have a reliable record of a site called “Vijasan Caves” in my knowledge base. It might be a lesser-known local name or a spelling/romanization variant.

Could you share:
- The country and state/region
- The nearest town/city or landmark
- Any alternate spellings you’ve seen (e.g., Bijasan, Bijasen, Vijaysan, Vyas/Byas, etc.)

With that, I can give you accurate details. If you’re unsure, a short description (Buddhist/Jain/Hindu site, rock-cut vs. natural cave, era, or any temple nearby) will also help.

Possibly related places people sometimes mean:
- Bijasan (Bijasen) Tekri and caves, Indore area, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Vyas (Byas) Gufa, near Mana/Badrinath, Uttarakhand, India
- Various rock‑cut Buddhist caves in Gujarat (e.g., Uperkot, Khambhalida, Talaja, Bava Pyara) that can be confused by name

If you have a photo or map pin, you can share it and I’ll identify it.
